text:
emma (product): Quick heads-up — Hosted Persistent Streams + Function Bridge is GA and we are starting a staged rollout to Hosted customers today. This adds long-lived keep-alive streams (session_id), server-side KV/session caching, and a bridge for server-managed function/tool invocations. Rolling across regions over the next 14 days.

priya (eng): TL;DR migration notes: update SDK to >= 0.8.0 to opt into session semantics. Legacy /v1/stream will still work but won't get session caching. New header: `x-rw-session-id`.

emma (product): Key user-facing changes: 1) persistent sessions reduce repeated prompt tokens via KV caching, 2) function-bridge lets you register server tools with stable invocation signatures (no need to re-send tool manifest each request), 3) keep-alive improves RTT for chat workloads.

oliver (eng-rt): quick example curl to start a session:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"mosaic-3-large","session_metadata":{"project":"payments"}}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/persistent_stream/start
```
The response returns session_id you can reuse in subsequent streaming requests.

docs-bot: Docs: <https://console.redwood.ai/docs/persistent-streams|Persistent Streams guide> and migration checklist: <https://console.redwood.ai/docs/migrations#persistent-streams|migration checklist>.

jamie (billing): How will billing change? Any session startup fees?

emma (product): Billing: token billing stays the same per-request/per-token. There is a tiny session-setup charge for very large sessions (applies to >72h sessions or >1M tokens) — we'll surface on invoices under "session overhead". Default hosted customers won't see material cost delta; Optimize will get recommendations for caching to lower unit costs.

jamie (billing): ok — will update pricing FAQ.

alex (sre): SRE action items: adding latency and error-rate SLO alerts for persistent sessions (tail 99p latency >250ms and error-rate spike >0.5%). Also need dashboard panels for session churn and KV hit-rate. @priya can you share the metric names?

priya (eng): Metrics: `rp.session.latency_ms`, `rp.session.kv_hit_ratio`, `rp.session.churn_count`. I'll push a Grafana dashboard template to infra repo in next PR.

deploy-bot: release persisted-streams v1.0 deployed to canary region us-west-2 at 1824567920 — canary key: canary-persist-001

emma (product): Canary customers will be observed for 72 hours; we expect to open to broader hosted accounts on day 3 if no regressions. We'll send a follow-up email to customers that are likely to be impacted (large chat workloads).

oliver (eng-rt): Note: HTTP/2 clients had an edge-case with cookie passthrough; fixed in patch 0.8.1 — canary rolling now. If you see 502s on streaming with session_id, please @eng-oncall.

alex (sre): Added temporary rate-limit guard for sessions to avoid thundering starts: 30 new sessions/min per account by default. We can tune after more telemetry.

priya (eng): For SDKs: Node/Python/Go releases with session helpers and automatic reconnect are landing today. Please use the new `session.keepAlive()` helper to preserve sockets.

emma (product): Action items for teams:
• DevEx: update quickstarts and sample apps (linked).
• Support: FAQ + canned responses prepared (will push shortly).
• Sales/AE: we have an FAQ doc and migration playbook at the docs link above — flag accounts that should be invited to early opt-in.

maria (ceo): Huge thanks to the team — this should unlock a lot of low-latency chat and multi-turn tool workflows for customers. :party: Please highlight any customer escalations immediately.

priya (eng): Small known limitation to call out publicly: session KV is best-effort across autoscaled backends; do not depend on absolute strict-consistency for very high write rates — we'll document consistency model.

emma (product): Will post a short post-mortem style launch note in #announcements with follow-ups and a timeline for forced migration (if any). For now: opt-in + staged rollout.

jamie (billing): I updated the internal pricing note, will send to finance for FYQ2 impact review.

alex (sre): Monitoring hooks added, I'll ping here if we see anything during canary window.

emma (product): Thanks everyone — ping me directly with any rollout blockers. :rocket:
